description: Istanbul Airports Monthly Freight Traffic is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı. This dataset includes monthly freight traffic data of Istanbul airports for domestic and international routes. Coverage: Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı. The publisher named on the listing is Kültür ve Turizm Bakanlığı. Its keywords include aylık, dış hat, havalimanı, iç hat, yük trafiği. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2024-11-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
